ICS 67.220.10FAD 09Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of test for whole and ground cloves [Syzygium aromaticum (L.) Merril et L. M. Perry].1.2 This standard also covers the recommendation relating to the storage and transport conditions for cloves (see Annex A) for information.2.
